subject: Implementation kickoff: cost/perf tuning and routing plan for BrightPath
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Santiago Rueda <santiago@brightpath.ai>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-03-21T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Implementation kickoff & initial cost/perf plan

Hi Santiago —

Thanks for the call yesterday. Per our discussion, we want to get an implementation kickoff scheduled and align on the cost/performance tuning items we'll address during onboarding (batching, prefix/KV caching, quantization profiles, and routing policies).

Proposed kickoff agenda (30–45m):
- Quick intro & roles
- Target traffic profile and peak RPS
- Initial perf goals (p50/p95 latency, tokens/sec cost budget)
- Batching/caching defaults and required changes for EU privacy
- Quantization profile selection & perf tradeoffs
- Routing policy (dedicated capacity vs hosted fallback)
- Next steps & owners

Can you share two 30–45m slots on Wed/Thu? Also please confirm the expected peak RPS and a representative sequence length distribution (avg/95th).

I'll attach the onboarding checklist and a short CSV of quantization profiles we usually test.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: Santiago Rueda <santiago@brightpath.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>, Elena Novak <elena@brightpath.ai>
Date: 2028-03-21T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Implementation kickoff & initial cost/perf plan

Karthik —

Thanks, Wed/Thu both look good. Thu 10:00–10:45 PDT would work for our infra and product leads.

A couple quick details to help the agenda:
- Peak: ~25 req/s sustained for short bursts (expected warm-up to handle up to 40 req/s during campaigns)
- Avg sequence length: ~350 tokens (95th: ~1,100 tokens)
- Important: EU data residency + PII cannot leave our VPC; we will likely request Redwood Private in a VPC (or at minimum dedicated capacity with SOC2/KMS assurances).

I'll attach the security questionnaire for your team.

—Santiago
Santiago Rueda
Head of Platform, BrightPath AI

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
To: Santiago Rueda <santiago@brightpath.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-03-21T12:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Implementation kickoff & initial cost/perf plan

Hi Santiago —

Great — Thu 10:00 PDT is on our side as well. Thanks for the traffic profile; that helps a lot. I sketched a focused plan below that we can review in the kickoff and iterate on during the first two sprints.

High-level implementation plan (first 2 sprints):
1) Preflight and baseline (Week 0–1)
   - Run a representative perf test using your 95th-length samples (owner: Redwood eng). Attachment: implementation-checklist-v1.pdf (preflight items).
   - Baseline cost and latency metrics (p50/p95, token cost) captured to shared Drive.

2) Batching & dynamic batching (Week 1–2)
   - Default dynamic batch target: 8–12 requests per batch for initial phase (tune to 4–16 depending on latency SLO).
   - Configure per-route max-latency budget to avoid head-of-line waits (owner: Redwood eng / BrightPath infra).

3) KV/prefix caching (Week 1–3)
   - Enable prefix KV caching for repeated prompts and user context, TTL tuning based on session patterns (owner: BrightPath product + Redwood CS).

4) Quantization profiling (Week 2–4)
   - Initial profiles to test (see quant-profiles.csv): q8_mixed (balanced), q4_high-sparsity (aggressive cost savings), and int8_dynamic (low-latency focus).
   - Recommendation for EU private deployments: prefer q8_mixed for first pass to preserve quality.

5) Routing policy & fallbacks
   - Primary: Dedicated capacity in your EU VPC (pinned model version).
   - Secondary: Hosted fallback to a verified, smaller variant (strictly for non-PII traffic) with automatic failover and per-route filters to avoid PII leakage.

Compliance & security notes:
- We will provide SOC2 and KMS integration docs during kickoff. If you require an air-gapped on-prem package, we can scope separately.

Attachments included for the kickoff: implementation-checklist-v1.pdf, quant-profiles.csv. I'll bring a short live demo of a perf test and cost breakdown in the meeting.

Proposed immediate owners and due dates:
- Karthik: schedule kickoff + update deal record (by Thu EOD)
- Redwood eng (assigned at kickoff): baseline perf run (within 48 hours of kickoff)
- Marissa (CS): draft canary plan + quality guardrails (by end of week 1)

Looking forward to the call.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Implementation Lead, Redwood Inference

From: Santiago Rueda <santiago@brightpath.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Cc: Elena Novak <elena@brightpath.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@brightpath.com>
Date: 2028-03-22T08:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Implementation kickoff & initial cost/perf plan

On Wed, Mar 21, 2028 at 12:45 PM Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com> wrote:
> Hi Santiago —
>
> Great — Thu 10:00 PDT is on our side as well. Thanks for the traffic profile; that helps a lot. I sketched a focused plan below...

Thanks for the detail — this looks good and is very actionable. A couple clarifications before the kickoff:
- We definitely need SOC2 documentation and evidence of KMS/HSM options; our security team needs those before we route any PII. I've attached the security questionnaire (brightpath-security-questionnaire.pdf).
- For the fallback policy: the fallback must never be used for PII-bearing requests even during outages. Can the per-route filter be enforced at the edge before routing?
- We will likely ask for a short canary where 5% traffic goes to a quantized model to validate quality before a wider rollout.

If you can confirm the per-route enforcement method and the default quant profile (q8_mixed as suggested) that would be helpful to include in our procurement notes.

I'll see you on Thu 10:00 PDT.

—Santiago

Attachments: brightpath-security-questionnaire.pdf

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Implementation kickoff & initial cost/perf plan — internal next steps

Quick internal recap and owners (putting this in thread so BrightPath has visibility):

Summary
- Customer: BrightPath AI (EU data residency, PII restriction)
- Traffic: ~25 req/s peak; avg 350 tokens; 95th ~1,100 tokens
- Primary ask: Private deployment (EU VPC) + SOC2/KMS evidence

Immediate owners & deliverables
- Karthik: confirm kickoff time in HubSpot + attach procurement notes (due Thu COB)
- Kimberly: baseline perf run plan + proposed dynamic batching thresholds and canary plan (deliverable: canary plan doc; due Mon)
- Marissa (CS): gather SOC2 artifacts and KMS integration checklist; pre-fill the security questionnaire where possible (deliverable: security-pack.zip; due Mon)
- Eng (TBD): implement per-route edge filter to ensure PII never leaves the VPC; baseline perf run after kickoff

Risk notes
- Fallback routing must be policy-enforced at edge. If enforcement requires additional infra work, we will scope it as part of the Private deployment statement of work (SOW).
- Quantization: start conservative (q8_mixed) for quality, run 5% canary, then iterate to q4 profile if quality delta within tolerance.

Next meeting: Kickoff Thu 2028-03-23 10:00 PDT (calendar invite sent).

I'll upload the SOC2 artifacts and the implementation checklist to the Drive and link in HubSpot.

Thanks — will update after kickoff.

Marissa Cole
Director, Customer Success, Redwood Inference
